name: gizza-ai/zero-width-cleaner
summary: Detect and strip invisible zero-width spaces, joiners, BOMs and other non-printing characters from text

tool.description: Remove invisible characters from text: zero-width spaces/joiners, word joiner, invisible math operators, byte-order mark (BOM), bidirectional formatting controls and soft hyphens. remove_zero_width, remove_bidi and remove_soft_hyphen default true; replace_nbsp (default false) normalizes non-breaking/odd spaces; replacement is substituted for each removed character.
